titleEn: Turn order confirmation messages on or off

en: Customers do not get order confirmations

steps: Open Bot in Settings, then Switches
Turn Order confirmation messages on: the screen asks you to confirm because customers will receive messages
Turning it off needs no confirmation
edgeCases: Needs an approved order_confirmation / cod_confirmation template
Ebda Store bridge down/unbound: store-linked features fall back (agent answers text only; orders cannot be created; COD outcomes cannot be recorded) and alert fires
Turning ON needs a single-use confirm token from the preview step, bound to the exact change; a replay or an edited change is refused (409 confirm_invalid / confirm_expired)
Every toggle writes an audit row (store_link.toggle) naming the switch and the value
